description: This Java source file defines the ApiDescrHandler class, which implements a SAX parser handler to parse XML descriptions of Android API elements such as packages, classes, methods, and fields. It builds an internal data structure representing the API specifications.

classes.name: ApiDescrHandler
classes.description: Implements a SAX handler for parsing XML API description files, managing the construction of ApiList objects and associated package, class, method, and field info during XML parsing.

methods.name: ApiDescrHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with an ApiList instance.

methods.name: getApiList
methods.description: Returns the current state of the ApiList after parsing is complete.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the beginning of an XML element, creating or updating internal data structures based on element type.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, finalizing the addition of methods, classes, or packages to the internal structures.
